item.content:encoded:
Just let you know that a simple way to work with Proxmox on mac is natively virtualize it under UTM or the apple Virtualization frameworks.
It's not baremetal but it's working great with a very lightweight virtualization layer.
I search through the forum and I don't find anyone using this way.
It's not quite good for the production but for the homelab projcts it's a great way to implement and use proxmox.

PVE has (and continues to have) a large presence in the homelab/self hosting crowd.
